common.needsConnection: Needs a connection — try again when you are online.
common.offlineCopy: Offline copy — last refreshed earlier on this phone.
login.fillBoth: Enter your employee code or email and your password.
login.forgot: Forgotten? Ask your site safety officer for a reset.
login.pendingKept: {count, plural, one {# unsent item is kept on this phone} other {# unsent items are kept on this phone}} and will sync after you sign in.
login.enrolHint: Your site safety officer gave you a one-time code (valid 24 hours). Choose a password to finish.
login.pwRule: At least 8 characters with letters and numbers (12 for staff).
login.pwMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
login.mfaTitle: Enter the code from your authenticator app
login.mfaEnrolHint: Your role needs two-step sign-in. Add this key to an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Aegis, Microsoft Authenticator), then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
login.mustChangeHint: Your password was issued or reset by an administrator and must be changed before you continue.
login.mustChangeHintNamed: {name}, your password was issued or reset by an administrator and must be changed before you continue.
server.title: Connect to your company's SafeWorks server
server.hint: The web address your safety team gave you, starting with https://
server.invalid: Enter a full address starting with https://
server.notSafeworks: That address answered, but it is not a SafeWorks server.
server.unreachable: Could not reach that address. Check the spelling and your connection.
logout.blockedBody: {count, plural, one {# item on this phone has not reached the server yet.} other {# items on this phone have not reached the server yet.}} Signing out would delete them. Sync first, then sign out.
logout.blockedOffline: You are offline — the items will sync as soon as you have signal.
logout.keepHint: If you must hand the phone over now, lock the app instead: your items stay encrypted on this phone and sync when you sign in again.
home.headline: See something? Say something.
home.report: Report a hazard or good practice
home.allClear: Nothing waiting for you. Walk the site and report what you see.
home.criticalSub: Stop-work alerts need an acknowledgement within {minutes} min
home.overdueSub: Owners are reminded; escalation starts at day +1
home.dueTodaySub: Complete with an after-photo before the shift ends
home.verifySub: Compare before and after, then decide
home.triageSub: Rate, route or return within one working day
home.triageLate: {count, plural, one {# report past the triage SLA} other {# reports past the triage SLA}}
home.inspectionsSub: Scheduled or started, due by tomorrow
home.returned: Returned to you with a question
home.returnedSub: Reply so the officer can finish triage
home.reportsCount: {count, plural, one {# report in 7 days} other {# reports in 7 days}}
home.noReportsWeek: No reports here in the last 7 days.
home.repeatRuns: {count, plural, one {# inspection failed} other {# inspections failed}}
home.noRepeat: No repeats — nothing came up twice.
report.title: Quick report
report.areaHint: Required when there is no GPS fix.
report.noAreas: No areas set up for this site yet.
report.describeHint: Say what, where and who could be hurt — not who did it.
report.describePlaceholder: e.g. Open edge on level 3 near the lift shaft, no guard rail
report.fixedHint: You removed the hazard yourself before leaving
report.dangerHint: Alerts the site head and the safety officer at once
report.anonymousHint: Nobody — not even the admin — can see who sent it. You still see it under My reports.
report.describeActHint: Describe the act, not the person. There is no field for a worker's name.
report.submitHint: Choose a type and a category, then add a photo or a description.
report.needArea: No GPS fix — choose the area.
report.needPhotoOrText: Add a photo or a short description.
report.needWhatYouDid: Say what you did to fix it.
report.saveFailed: Could not save on this phone: {reason}
report.savedPending: Kept on this phone. The number arrives when it reaches the server.
report.willTell: We will tell you when it is fixed.
reports.emptyBody: Your reports appear here with their status, even while offline.
reports.triageEmptyBody: Every report at your sites has been triaged.
obs.title: Report
obs.dangerBanner: Danger now — stop work was raised by the reporter
obs.refreshFailed: Could not refresh from the server; showing the last copy.
obs.noOfflineCopy: Full details, photos and the timeline load when you are back online.
obs.voicePending: A voice note is waiting to upload from this phone.
obs.returnedBody: Reply with the missing detail and the report goes back into triage.
obs.commentKind.rejected_offline_decisio: Offline decision not applied (someone triaged first)
triage.title: Triage
triage.dupHint: {count, plural, one {# similar report in the last 24 h} other {# similar reports in the last 24 h}} — same area and category.
triage.stopWork: Extreme — stop work. The site head and HSE manager are alerted on sync; an interim control is required this shift.
triage.interimHint: What keeps people safe until the action is done.
triage.pickMatrixFirst: Pick likelihood × severity to pre-fill the action.
triage.defaultsFrom: Pre-filled from the report, the area owner and the band rule — change anything.
triage.bandDue: Band {band} ({score}) · due date from the band rule
triage.question: Question to the reporter
triage.questionHint: The reporter is notified and the report waits in Returned.
triage.noReturnAnonymous: Anonymous and QR reports cannot be returned — the reporter cannot be reached.
triage.discardHint: The reporter is told the reason category. Discard rate is on the dashboard.
triage.masterHint: The open report this one duplicates. The reporter is told when the master closes.
triage.masterSearch: Search by case number or text
triage.noMaster: No open reports in this area.
triage.escalateHint: Records when you learned of it and opens an incident with the same case number. Follow the site's paper procedure for statutory notices.
triage.learnedHint: Statutory timers run from this time — confirm it carefully.
triage.needEmployer: Choose the employer involved (own company counts).
triage.needAction: Accept & assign needs at least one action.
triage.needInterimAction: High and Extreme actions need an interim control.
action.title: Action
action.completionHint: What was done, by whom, when.
action.causeHint: Why it happened and what stops it recurring.
action.completedSaved: Completion saved — the verifier is notified on sync
action.needAfterPhoto: An after-photo is required — the server rejects a completion without one.
action.reopenHint: Not effective reopens it to the same owner with a new due date ({date}).
action.disputeHint: For example: not our scope, needs another trade. The reminder ladder pauses while the officer decides.
action.thirdRequest: This is the third date-change request — the site head must decide it.
action.needFutureDate: Choose a date in the future.
action.decideHint: An approved date change moves the due date; the original date is kept for the on-time KPI.
action.cancelHint: Cancelling needs a reason and a site head's approval, recorded with the request.
action.noSiteHead: No site head or HSE manager is set up for this site, so the action cannot be cancelled here.
action.awaitingVerifier: Completed — waiting for someone else to verify.
action.timelineOffline: The timeline loads when you are back online.
actions.emptyBodyMine: Actions assigned to you appear here, overdue first.
actions.emptyBodySite: Actions from every source at your sites appear here.
actions.verifyEmptyBody: Completed actions that you did not own appear here for verification.
insp.emptyBody: Scheduled runs appear here. Scan an asset QR or start a spot inspection from a template.
insp.noTemplates: No active templates on this phone — sync to fetch them.
insp.noMatchShowingAll: No template is mapped to this area or asset; showing all active templates.
run.headerOnce: Filled once; site, time and GPS are locked
run.unanswered: {count, plural, one {# required item unanswered} other {# required items unanswered}}
run.missingActions: {count, plural, one {# failed item needs a draft action} other {# failed items need draft actions}}
run.needTag: Choose Safe to use or Do not use for this equipment.
run.restored: We restored your answers after the app closed.
run.exitBody: Your answers are saved on this phone and sent to the server; you can continue later from Inspections.
run.templateMissing: This template version is not on the phone yet. Sync and try again.
run.answersOffline: Answers and photos load when you are back online.
run.reopenHint: The locked report is marked superseded; the inspector signs again.
scan.noDetector: This browser cannot scan QR codes directly — scan with the phone camera app or type the code below.
scan.cameraDenied: Camera permission was refused. Type the code instead.
scan.manualHint: The token printed under the QR, the full link, or an equipment tag number.
scan.invalid: That does not look like a SafeWorks code.
scan.notFound: No area or equipment matches this code
scan.doNotUse: DO NOT USE — this equipment is tagged out
scan.areaFound: This QR is for {area}. Report what you see or start an inspection here.
outbox.clearedSynced: {count, plural, one {# synced item cleared} other {# synced items cleared}}
outbox.emptyBody: Everything you did on this phone has reached the server.
outbox.backoff: next retry about {s} s after the last one
outbox.fixLoaded: Loaded the rejected report — fix it and submit again. Server said: {reason}
outbox.conflictHint: Someone else changed this record first. Your decision was kept as a comment on it.
outbox.diagCopied: Diagnostics copied — paste them into your problem report.
notif.emptyBody: Alerts, reminders and closure notices appear here.
settings.langHint: Showing the app in {name}. Reports keep the language they were typed in.
settings.digestHint: Overdue actions and reminders beyond the daily push cap are bundled here.
settings.quietHint: No non-critical pushes between {start} and {end}. Stop-work alerts always come through.
settings.capHint: At most {cap} reminder pushes a day; the rest go to the digest.
settings.privacyBody: What we collect (your reports, photos, location at capture, device), why, how long we keep it and how to ask for a copy or deletion.
settings.noticeMissing: The notice has not been published yet. Ask your HSE manager.
settings.problemBody: Something not working? Send us what happened — device, app version and the sync log are attached automatically.
settings.openLibrary: Open procedures, first aid and regulations
photo.notImage: That file is not a photo.
photo.markupHint: Drag a box over anything that should not be readable. Blur is burnt into the photo before upload and cannot be undone after submit.
photo.applyBlur: {count, plural, one {Apply # blur box} other {Apply # blur boxes}}
photo.blurApplied: {count, plural, one {# area blurred} other {# areas blurred}}
qr.title: Report a hazard
qr.chooseLanguageSub: No sign-in needed. Takes about 30 seconds.
qr.noToken: Scan the QR poster in your area to open the report form.
qr.badToken: This QR code is no longer active. Ask the site safety officer for the new poster.
qr.offline: No connection — you can still fill the form. It is sent when the signal is back.
qr.queued: {count, plural, one {# report on this phone waiting to send} other {# reports on this phone waiting to send}}
qr.anonymousHint: Nothing about you is stored. If you switch this off you can leave a name and phone, visible only to the site safety team.
qr.name: Your name
qr.phoneHint: So the safety officer can call you back. Stored encrypted.
qr.privacyLine: Your report goes to the {org} safety team. Photos lose location data before upload.
qr.willSend: It will be sent automatically when the signal is back. Keep this page open or come back to it.
qr.photosDone: {count, plural, one {# photo uploaded} other {# photos uploaded}}
qr.statusHint: Only someone with this link can see the status. Save it to follow what happens.
qr.statusNotFound: No report matches this link. Check the case number and the secret in the link.
qr.statusPrivacy: This page shows only the status — never who reported it.
